title: Baar Baar Dekho
desc: Mathematics professor Jai gets cold feet about marrying his girlfriend Diya. After the marriage is cancelled, he goes on a journey through time, seeing what it would be like if he married Diya.

title: Good Newwz
desc: Two married couples are unsuccessful in conceiving and seek medical treatment. However, they end up in a complicated situation after their doctor makes a blunder.

title: Main Prem Ki Diwani Hoon
desc: Sanjana falls in love with Prem Kishen after mistaking him for his boss, Prem Kumar, whom she is actually supposed to marry. But, the relationship is threatened when Prem Kishen reveals the truth.

title: Sardaar Gabbar Singh
desc: The kingdom of Rathanpur is forced to face the wrath of Bhairav Singh, who unceremoniously usurps their land. They later find respite when Gabbar Singh, a brave policeman, takes on their oppressor.

title: Daringbaaz 3
desc: When Chai finds out that Meera loves Siddharth, he does everything in his power to unite them, even though he is madly in love with her.

title: Sher Ka Shikaar
desc: A man, who is famous in his village for killing man-eating tigers, unwillingly becomes a part of a conspiracy surrounding illegal drugs.
